content.title: Conntrack Sync
content.subtitle: Connection tracking synchronization between firewall nodes

delete.title: Remove Conntrack Sync Configuration
delete.description: This will delete the entire conntrack-sync configuration. Connection tracking synchronization will stop immediately. This action cannot be undone.

modal.rowNameRequired: All interface rows must have a name.
modal.portRange: Interface "{name}" port must be between 1 and 65535.
modal.duplicateNames: Duplicate interface names are not allowed.
modal.title: Configure Conntrack Sync
modal.description: Synchronize connection tracking tables between firewall nodes for high availability.
modal.interfacesIntro: Configure the interface used to exchange conntrack updates. Leave Peer empty to use multicast (default 225.0.0.50), or enter a unicast IPv4 address to bypass multicast.
modal.noInterfaces: No interfaces configured. Add one below.
modal.acceptProtocolsHint: Local conntrack entries for selected protocols will be synced to the peer.
modal.expectSyncHint: Synchronize helper-created expect entries for application-layer protocols.
modal.failoverHint: VRRP sync-group used to determine active/backup state.
modal.multicastGroupHint: IPv4 multicast address used when no unicast peer is configured.
modal.listenAddressesHint: Local IPv4 addresses to listen on for incoming sync traffic.
modal.ignoreAddressesHint: IPv4/IPv6 addresses or prefixes excluded from synchronization.
modal.disableExternalCacheHint: Directly inject flow-states into the kernel connection tracking system of the backup node.
modal.disableSyslogHint: Suppress connection tracking event logging via syslog.
modal.startupResyncHint: Request a full conntrack table resync from the peer at startup.
